summary: Connect a vector-output dense–ReLU layer and all its gradients to an actual TorchLean graph and automatically generated backward.

Verify a separately supplied parallel binary32 forward implementation with a fixed reduction tree and fresh scratch in one bounded cooperating thread array; prove a complete admitted execution and conditional stored-word bounds while distinguishing correctness for all admitted executions.
remaining: Implemented: actual TorchLean matrix graph and generated VJP; balanced-tree numerical bounds; the shape-specialized forward instruction list and complete selected execution through every reduction round, barrier, bias/ReLU output store and thread exit; derived stored reference words, unchanged inputs, preserved extents and full-trace access safety. The same trace has a proved graph admission certificate, using derived read sources, chronological write ordering and actual barrier edges, with no circular order/read-source chain. Selected stored-word accuracy follows under the existing explicit RowInput encoding and range conditions. Missing: full-layer actual-writer and barrier-timing proofs for arbitrary admitted executions; universal stored numerical correspondence to TorchLean including the padded real-tree identity; an empty-output no-launch wrapper; and the parallel backward kernel and its proofs. No desired load values, intermediate accuracy or memory validity are assumed by the selected execution proof.

from.quote:
The layer takes an input vector x of length n, a trainable m-by-n weight matrix W,
and a bias vector b of length m. It returns y_i=max(sum_j W_ij*x_j+b_i,0).
Its automatically generated TorchLean backward takes an incoming sensitivity
vector d of length m. With g_i=d_i on a positive affine value and zero otherwise,
it returns dx_j=sum_i W_ij*g_i, dW_ij=g_i*x_j and db_i=g_i. A zero derivative at
an exactly zero affine value is a chosen convention; ordinary mathematical
differentiation requires every relevant affine value to be nonzero.

theorem forward_coordinate (x : Tensor ℝ (column n)) (w : Tensor ℝ (matrix m n))
    (b : Tensor ℝ (column m)) (row : Fin m) :
    Spec.get2 ((graph m n).forward (inputs x w b)) row 0 =
      max ((∑ j : Fin n, Spec.get2 w row j * Spec.get2 x j 0) + Spec.get2 b row 0) 0 :=

  products s ++ (List.range s.depth).flatMap (round s) ++ output s

    (Scalar.BinOp.eval .and (BitVec.ofNat 32 t.val) (BitVec.ofNat 32 (s.width-1))).toNat = t.val % s.width ∧
    (Scalar.BinOp.eval .shr (BitVec.ofNat 32 t.val) (BitVec.ofNat 32 s.depth)).toNat = t.val / s.width :=

theorem guarded_load_execution (cfg : Config n) (state : Parallel.State n) (t : Fin n)
    (space : Space) (destination address index : Nat)
    (valid : (state.lanes t).scalar.preds 0 = true →
      Scalar.addressIndex (arena state (some space)) ((state.lanes t).scalar.addrs address) = .ok index) :
    SegmentRegular cfg t [guarded space (.load destination (.reg address))] state ∧
    (segmentReference cfg t [guarded space (.load destination (.reg address))] state).1 =
      afterLoad state t space destination index :=

passage.quote:
theorem product_phase_exists (s : Shape) (b : Bounds s) (global shared : List Word)
    (seeds : Fin s.threads → Scalar.State)
    (globalBound : s.globalWords ≤ global.length) (sharedBound : s.sharedWords ≤ shared.length) :
    ∃ events final, ConcreteRuns (config s b) (program s) (initial s global shared seeds) events final ∧
      final.global = global ∧ final.shared.length = shared.length ∧
      (∀ t : Fin s.threads, final.shared[t.val]? =
        some (nodeValue s global (t.val/s.width) 0 (t.val%s.width))) ∧
      (∀ t, (final.lanes t).scalar.pc = 22 ∧ (final.lanes t).halted = false) ∧
      final.barrier = Barrier.reset 1 ∧ final.site = none ∧
      (∀ event ∈ events, AccessSafe (initial s global shared seeds) event) ∧
      (∀ t, (final.lanes t).scalar.regs 0 = BitVec.ofNat 32 t.val ∧
        (final.lanes t).scalar.regs 1 = BitVec.ofNat 32 (t.val%s.width) ∧
        (final.lanes t).scalar.regs 2 = BitVec.ofNat 32 (t.val/s.width)) :=

passage.quote:
theorem selected_forward_exists (s : Shape) (b : Bounds s) (global shared : List Word)
    (seeds : Fin s.threads → Scalar.State)
    (globalBound : s.globalWords ≤ global.length) (sharedBound : s.sharedWords ≤ shared.length) :
    ∃ events final, Runs (config s b) (program s) (initial s global shared seeds) events final ∧
      (∀ t, (final.lanes t).halted = true ∧ (final.lanes t).scalar.pc = (program s).length-1) ∧
      (∀ r, r<s.rows → final.global[s.outputBase+r]? = some (forwardWord s global r)) ∧
      (∀ i, i<s.outputBase → final.global[i]? = global[i]?) ∧
      final.global.length = global.length ∧ final.shared.length = shared.length ∧
      final.barrier = Barrier.reset (s.depth+1) ∧ final.site = none ∧
      (∀ event ∈ events, AccessSafe (initial s global shared seeds) event) :=

theorem selected_forward_accuracy (s : Shape) (b : Bounds s) (global shared : List Word)
    (seeds : Fin s.threads → Scalar.State)
    (globalBound : s.globalWords ≤ global.length) (sharedBound : s.sharedWords ≤ shared.length) :
    ∃ events final, Runs (config s b) (program s) (initial s global shared seeds) events final ∧
      (∀ t, (final.lanes t).halted = true) ∧
      (∀ r, r<s.rows → ∀ i : Ptx.Binary32.Reduction.RowInput,
        Ptx.Binary32.Reduction.words i.tree =

        Ptx.Binary32.finiteReal final.global[s.outputBase+r]! = some (max i.affine 0) ∧
          |max i.affine 0-max i.idealAffine 0| ≤ i.error) :=

from.quote:
The witness retains concrete-read evidence through every instruction and
barrier. Replaying its emitted memory events checks every load value and
reproduces the final arrays. Each load is traced to the initial contents or the
last preceding store to that location, with global and shared storage kept
separate.

passage.quote:
theorem selected_forward_checked (s : Shape) (b : Bounds s) (global shared : List Word)
    (seeds : Fin s.threads → Scalar.State)
    (globalBound : s.globalWords ≤ global.length) (sharedBound : s.sharedWords ≤ shared.length) :
    ∃ events final, ConcreteRuns (config s b) (program s) (initial s global shared seeds) events final ∧
      Replay.trace ⟨global,shared⟩ events = some (Replay.arrays final) ∧
      Replay.ReadOrigins ⟨global,shared⟩ events ∧
      (∀ t, (final.lanes t).halted = true ∧ (final.lanes t).scalar.pc = (program s).length-1) ∧
      (∀ r, r<s.rows → final.global[s.outputBase+r]? = some (forwardWord s global r)) ∧
      (∀ i, i<s.outputBase → final.global[i]? = global[i]?) ∧
      final.global.length = global.length ∧ final.shared.length = shared.length ∧
      final.barrier = Barrier.reset (s.depth+1) ∧ final.site = none ∧
      (∀ event ∈ events, AccessSafe (initial s global shared seeds) event) :=

from.quote:
The selected witness also supplies a graph on exactly those memory
events, with a proved read source for every load and an order for writes to the
same location. A chronological certificate proves that this graph satisfies the
existing memory constraints and the ordering derived from its actual completed
barriers. It also excludes circular chains through those order and read-source
edges. This establishes an admitted execution with the stated stored outputs.

passage.quote:
theorem selected_forward_admitted (s : Shape) (b : Bounds s) (global shared : List Word)
    (seeds : Fin s.threads → Scalar.State)
    (globalBound : s.globalWords ≤ global.length) (sharedBound : s.sharedWords ≤ shared.length) :
    ∃ events final, ∃ run : ConcreteRuns (config s b) (program s) (initial s global shared seeds) events final,
      ∃ source co,
      Graph.Ordered.Valid (Memory.graph (program s) global shared events source co)
        (Memory.runOrder run.toRuns (show (initial s global shared seeds).barrier = Barrier.reset 0 from rfl) source co).cross ∧
      (∀ i, ¬Path (SharedReduction.Machine.Memory.grounding
        (Memory.graph (program s) global shared events source co)
        (Memory.runOrder run.toRuns (show (initial s global shared seeds).barrier = Barrier.reset 0 from rfl) source co).cross) i i) ∧
      (∀ t, (final.lanes t).halted = true ∧ (final.lanes t).scalar.pc = (program s).length-1) ∧
      (∀ r, r<s.rows → final.global[s.outputBase+r]? = some (forwardWord s global r)) ∧
      (∀ i, i<s.outputBase → final.global[i]? = global[i]?) ∧
      final.global.length = global.length ∧ final.shared.length = shared.length ∧
      final.barrier = Barrier.reset (s.depth+1) ∧ final.site = none ∧
      (∀ event ∈ events, AccessSafe (initial s global shared seeds) event) ∧
      (∀ r, r<s.rows → ∀ i : Ptx.Binary32.Reduction.RowInput,
        Ptx.Binary32.Reduction.words i.tree =
          Ptx.Binary32.Reduction.balanced s.depth 0 (operands s global r) →
        i.bias = global[s.biasBase+r]! →
        Ptx.Binary32.finiteReal final.global[s.outputBase+r]! = some (max i.affine 0) ∧
          |max i.affine 0-max i.idealAffine 0| ≤ i.error) :=
